tags: @guarantee ok.only-first-word "welcome to our website" gives "Welcome to our website"
@guarantee ok.accents-removed "café" gives "cafe", "résumé" gives "resume", "naïve" gives "naive" and "Zürich" gives "Zurich"
@guarantee ok.other-languages "München" gives "Munchen", "Crème brûlée" gives "Creme brulee" and "mañana" gives "manana"
@guarantee ok.mixed-scripts "Café Москва 한국어" gives "Cafe Москва 한국어"
@guarantee ok.double-quote-escaped "\"Hello\"" (the word Hello in double quotes) gives ""Hello""
@guarantee ok.single-quote-escaped the word Hello in single quotes gives the word Hello surrounded by "'" on both sides
@guarantee ok.dot-escaped "Hello." gives "Hello" followed by one backslash and a dot
@guarantee ok.parentheses-escaped "(test)" gives "test" wrapped in an escaped opening parenthesis and an escaped closing parenthesis, each preceded by one backslash
@guarantee ok.brackets-escaped "[abc]" gives "abc" wrapped in an escaped opening bracket and an escaped closing bracket, each preceded by one backslash
@guarantee ok.at-sign-not-escaped "user@domain.com" gives "user@domain" followed by one backslash and ".com"
@guarantee ok.lower-with-spaces "Hello World" gives "hello world" and "camelCase" gives "camel case"
@guarantee ok.from-other-cases "some-kebab-case" gives "some kebab case", "PascalCase" gives "pascal case" and "SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE" gives "screaming snake case"
@guarantee ok.mixed-separators "user_profile-settings" gives "user profile settings" and "  mixed   CASE   text  " gives "mixed case text"
@guarantee ok.default-chars-space "abc" padded to `length` 8 without `chars` gives "abc" with two spaces on the left and three spaces on the right
@guarantee ok.longer-or-equal-unchanged "abc" with `length` 3 gives "abc" and "abcdef" with `length` 3 gives "abcdef"
@guarantee ok.right-gets-extra "abc" padded to `length` 9 with `chars` "123" gives "123abc123" and to `length` 10 gives "123abc1231"
@guarantee ok.basic "hello" gives "olleh", "world" gives "dlrow" and "hello world" gives "dlrow olleh"
@guarantee ok.capitalized-words "hello world" gives "Hello World" and "HELLO WORLD" gives "Hello World"
@guarantee ok.from-camel-pascal "fooBar" gives "Foo Bar" and "PascalCase" gives "Pascal Case"
@guarantee ok.hyphen-underscore "hello-world" gives "Hello World" and "hello_world" gives "Hello World"
@guarantee ok.delimiters-trimmed "--foo-bar--" gives "Foo Bar" and "__FOO_BAR__" gives "Foo Bar"
@guarantee ok.acronym-and-numbers "XMLHttpRequest" gives "Xml Http Request", "_abc_123_def" gives "Abc 123 Def" and "12abc 12ABC" gives "12 Abc 12 Abc"
@guarantee ok.default-whitespace "  hello  " gives "hello" and a tab, newline and spaces around "hello" are removed too
@guarantee ok.single-char "--hello--" with `chars` "-" gives "hello" and "***hello***" with `chars` "*" gives "hello"
@guarantee ok.array-chars "!!@@hello@@!!" with `chars` ["!", "@"] gives "hello" and "123abc123" with `chars` ["1", "2", "3"] gives "abc"
@guarantee err.multi-char-string throws an error when `chars` is a string whose length is not 1
@guarantee ok.tags-restored "This is a <div> element." gives "This is a <div> element."
@guarantee ok.double-quote-restored "This is a "quote"" gives "This is a \"quote\"" (with plain double quotes)
@guarantee ok.single-quote-restored "'" is converted to a plain single quote
@guarantee ok.ampersand-restored "This is a & symbol" gives "This is a & symbol"
@guarantee ok.mixed-entities ""Hello & Welcome" <says the > user" gives "\"Hello & Welcome\" <says the > user"
@guarantee ok.upper-with-spaces "camelCase" gives "CAMEL CASE" and "some whitespace" gives "SOME WHITESPACE"
@guarantee ok.snake-and-email "user_name" gives "USER NAME" and "email-address" gives "EMAIL ADDRESS"
